feeds.title: Dividend Earner
feeds.description: In 2009, I fired my financial advisor and took control of my investments.Since then, I share my dividend growth investing experience along with my mistakes and learnings. Yes, it's not a perfect journey and other DIY investors can learn from my mistakes.

feeds.title: The Dividend Girl | Because life is all about money and a bunch of other things
feeds.description: I am a French Canadian, New Brunswicker. On August 5th, 2009, I reach my goal, which was to have 50 000$ in investment assets. My larger goal is to reach financial freedom and, if not retired early, at least live happily with my money and be able to reach my objectives.

feeds.title: Dividend Income Stocks
feeds.description: Hi! Welcome to Dividend Income Stocks. My name is German and I live in Montreal. I invest in Canadian dividend-paying stocks to generate passive income. I started this blog to keep track of my investment activities, portfolio value, and dividend income. I provide monthly updates on dividend income and monthly stock purchases.

feeds.title: The Dividend Guy Blog
feeds.description: One Guy's Journey to Freedom Through Passive Income. A Dividend Growth Investor. My name is Mike and I'm the author of The Dividend Guy Blog since 2010. Follow this blog to know about passive income through dividend investing.

feeds.title: Investment Talk
feeds.description: Blog by Susan Brunner on specific Canadian Stocks, especially ones that pay dividends and also reviews books.

feeds.title: All About The Dividends
feeds.description: Hello, everyone, I am Matthew. I am 33 years old and live in a small town in Ontario, Canada. Follow my blog as I share articles on all about dividends. At the beginning of 2016, I began to read investing blogs, and I have to say I am really enjoying them. They are a big reason why I have started this blog as they have inspired me to tell my story and journey through investing.

feeds.title: The Dividend Ninja
feeds.description: The Dividend Ninja is a Canadian blog about dividend stocks and personal finance! The Dividend Ninja invests in blue-chip dividend stocks, that are most likely to increase their dividend payment year after year. This blog is to empower investors to ditch overpriced and underperforming mutual funds and learn how to invest in Dividend Paying Stocks for themselves.

feeds.title: Passive Canadian Income
feeds.description: PassiveCanadianIncome Is a website documenting my journey towards Financial Independence. I plan to become more financially secure through various investments in Dividend stocks, our solar panel income, and various other investments. Retirement already feels closer!

feeds.title: Dividend Growth Investing & Retirement Blog
feeds.description: This personal finance blog is home to the Canadian Dividend All-Star List. The website covers a variety of investing, personal finance and retirement topics, but most articles focus on attaining financial freedom through dividend growth investing.

feeds.title: Dividend Strategy Blog
feeds.description: This website is useful in helping you understand what dividends are, why they are essential to achieving financial independence and finally, how to implement a simple and effective dividend-based investment plan.
